title: WARNING!  Don’t Let this EARNINGS Breakout Fool You!
speaker: Joseph James

macro_themes.view: Most earnings-driven breakouts give back the entire move the next day; short the bull traps, buy the dips.
Hourly in a bear market, so short the pops and buy the drops until bears run out of gas; long-term mostly bullish.

calls.condition: short bull trap above highs, target unfinished business ~29,545, then buy the breakout pullback / retest
calls.reason: Hourly still bearish and price is at overhead resistance after earnings pop; expects earnings breakout to fail, short bull trap down to unfinished breakout-pullback zone (~29,545), then buy. Daily shows breakout-pullback support and measured-move hold, convincing for a bullish reversal.
calls.quote: I would love to short a bull trap up here.

calls.condition: if price pushes higher overnight into ~7809-7819, short a bull trap there
calls.reason: Daily still a bull market (all-time highs unfinished business, no separation below 21 EMA) but hourly bearish; plans to short bull traps up into 7809-7819 resistance and buy the dip at the unfinished-business range below.
calls.quote: up in the resistance, let's let those buyers try to chase after it. I'm going to keep looking to ring that bell

notes: Recorded Tuesday evening after Netflix/SpaceX earnings, plan for Wednesday session; 'Tuesday' in transcript taken as recording day (2026-10-20); listing approx_date was 2026-10-21. S&P support gap 'below 46' too ambiguous to record.
